statBudget.rule: xStrength + xStamina + xIntelligence + xWisdom + xDexterity <= 66 (Agility, Speed, Aim not counted); over -> 'Stop hacking' and quit (client-only)

startingVitals.written: class:1:20:20:20:20:0:30:sex -> HP 20/20, SP 20/20, exp 0, ExpNeeded 30 for every class
startingVitals.notes: The rolled HP = Str + random(Sta) and SP formulas, and the Fighter SP = 0 lines, are computed but the Vit string uses literal 20s.

startingMap.notes: Unread: new characters start at the startPoint setting, which the pack's world seed (world.json) sets to x0y0 (1, 1).

nameRules.rule: letters only, either case: characters 1-20 are each compared with "a".."z" ignoring case, and anything else alerts first; Admin/Guide/Guardian are refused anywhere in the name (`contains`, any case). The monster-name check does nothing, so monster names are allowed. The server refuses only a name whose file exists (case-insensitive on Windows).
